title: 接缝不在奇点：量子力学与广义相对论的三十道裂缝 / The Seam Is Not at the Singularity: Thirty Cracks between Quantum Mechanics and General Relativity
description:
中文摘要。「量子力学与广义相对论根本矛盾」是一句被说了五十年的话。本文不做科普复述，也不站队某个纲领，而把它拆成 30 条可逐条核对的账目，按「量子一侧记什么／引力一侧记什么／冲突属于哪一类／落在哪个核心／在哪个尺度／能不能测／证据几级」重新编码。结果是四类：逻辑矛盾 4 条、接口缺失 13 条、记账冲突 8 条、定理边界 5 条。真正的逻辑矛盾只占 13.3%，而且没有一条已被直接测量；四条 A 级账目全部落在「已测」或「已证定理」一侧。越是被称作「根本」的冲突，越缺少实验接触；越是有实验接触的冲突，越已经被结算成定理或上限。

本文做什么。第一，给出 30 条账目的公开编码，任何人可以用 seams.csv 重算每一个计数。第二，把「根本矛盾」拆成四种类型，并给出每种的判据、结算条件与失败方式。第三，用六核心给每条账目定位：看见 6、跟上 6、记住 6、临界 5、选择 4、讲述 3；同时明确六核心能定位、不能裁决。第四，给出一张「如果……就……」的结算表：哪条实验或定理会结算哪条账目。

主要读数。类型：逻辑矛盾 4（13.3%）、接口缺失 13（43.3%）、记账冲突 8（26.7%）、定理边界 5（16.7%）。尺度：普朗克 10、宇宙 8、视界 7、实验室 5。可测性：直接 4、间接 12、不可测 14。等级：A 4、B 17、C 9。四种直接可测的账目（贝尔、纠缠/光锥、普朗克色散、真空能）全部已经有结算形式；四条逻辑矛盾没有一条被直接测量。六组物理侧的「同名不同物」：定域、真空、信息、对称性、背景、熵。六个候选纲领的声称覆盖：弦论/全息 17/30、圈量子引力 14/30、因果集/CDT 11/30、量子参考系 9/30、渐近安全 6/30、类比引力 3/30；没有一个超过 60%。

方法与数据。30 条账目来自量子引力、黑洞物理与量子基础的标准文献；每条必须能写成「量子一侧记什么／引力一侧记什么」的一对句子，并有一个结算条件。类型判定用五步决策树：能否写出 P 与 Q；是否不能同时为真；是否缺共同对象；是否同一个词指不同载体；是否有一条 no-go 定理。数据只有一份 data/seams.py，导出 seams.csv；8 图、11 表、交互页都由同一份数据生成。

边界与失败条件。30 条不是全体；类型边界有判断成分。保守读法下逻辑矛盾 2 条，基准 4 条，宽松 9 条；因此「只有四条」是基准编码，不是定理。单一编码者，没有第二编码者与 κ。可测性是「当前」的，不是永远的。覆盖矩阵只记录「声称处理」，不记录「成功」。十条命题中三条成立、两条部分、两条待检验、一条开放、一条被本文自己证伪、一条撤回；本文把 T9 的证伪与 T10 的撤回保留在登记簿里，不删除。

与系列的关系。本篇是系列第十五篇工作论文，与《六张账单的对账》直接对接：对账篇把本篇的十条命题并入总表，并把物理侧的六组同名不同物与原来的七组并列为十三组。六核心的详细定义见六本学术专著；本篇只借用判据，不替代其论证。

版本信息。2026-11-02 初版，68 页，30 条账目，8 图 11 表；PDF / HTML / Markdown / CSV / 交互页 / README / MANIFEST。

Abstract. “Quantum mechanics and general relativity are fundamentally incompatible” is a sentence repeated for fifty years. This paper neither popularises it nor takes sides among programmes. It breaks the sentence into 30 auditable ledger items, coded on what quantum theory and general relativity each put on their side, which kind of conflict this is, which of six cores it belongs to, at which scale, whether it is measurable, and at what evidence grade. The result: 4 logical contradictions, 13 missing interfaces, 8 accounting conflicts, and 5 theorem boundaries. Logical contradictions are only 13.3%, and not one has been directly measured; all four A-grade items sit on the “measured” or “proved theorem” side.

What the paper does. It publishes the coding so that every count can be recomputed from seams.csv; it separates four kinds of conflict with explicit criteria and settlement conditions; it locates each item with six cores (distinction 6, timing 6, memory 6, criticality 5, choice 4, interpretation 3) while insisting that the cores locate but do not adjudicate; and it gives an “if this, then that” table of which experiment or theorem would settle which item.

Main readings. Types: 4 logical, 13 interface, 8 accounting, 5 theorem-boundary. Scales: Planck 10, cosmos 8, horizon 7, laboratory 5. Measurability: direct 4, indirect 12, unmeasurable 14. Grades: A 4, B 17, C 9. Six physical cases of “same name, different object”: locality, vacuum, information, symmetry, background, entropy. Claimed coverage of six programmes: string/holography 17/30, loop quantum gravity 14/30, causal sets/CDT 11/30, quantum reference frames 9/30, asymptotic safety 6/30, analogue gravity 3/30; none exceeds 60%.

Method and data. The 30 items come from standard literature on quantum gravity, black-hole physics and quantum foundations. Each must be writable as a pair of sentences and must have a settlement condition. Type is assigned by a five-step decision tree. There is one data source, data/seams.py, exported to seams.csv; the 8 figures, 11 tables and interactive page are all generated from it.

Boundaries and failure conditions. The 30 items are not the whole literature; type boundaries involve judgement. A conservative reading gives 2 logical contradictions, the baseline 4, a permissive reading 9; “only four” is a coding result, not a theorem. There is one coder and no κ. Measurability is current, not permanent. The coverage matrix records claims, not success. Of ten propositions, three are supported, two partial, two pending, one open, one falsified by the paper itself and one withdrawn; the falsification and the withdrawal remain in the append-only register.

Relation to the series. This is the fifteenth working paper of the series and connects directly to Reconciling Six Ledgers, which incorporates its ten propositions into the master table and adds the six physical cases of “same name, different object” to the original seven. The six cores are defined in the six academic monographs; this paper borrows their criteria without replacing their arguments.

Edition. First edition, 2026-11-02, 68 pages, 30 items, 8 figures and 11 tables; PDF / HTML / Markdown / CSV / interactive explorer / README / MANIFEST.
